implementationPolicy: A bounded production acquisition starts only when no LastWar process exists at the selected installation's exact Game\LastWar.exe path.
After the selected launcher is started, the helper accepts exactly one newly observed process at that exact executable path and records its positive PID and start time.

The helper generates a per-run launchSessionId and writes launchSessionId, selected profileId and exact gamePid into the request-owned command; the injected probe copies those fields into heartbeat/failure/proven result data.

The desktop validates helper profileId, launchSessionId, positive gamePid and exact selected game path, then requires the immutable result bytes to match that same profile/session/PID tuple before persistence.
Loaded-probe reuse and image-name-wide restart/termination were removed from this bounded production helper path. If the selected game is already running, the operation fails closed.

If restoration cannot complete while the helper-owned game remains open, recovery state is retained and the helper reports that scoped native close is required instead of terminating every LastWar.exe process.
